lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: Admin redesign step A7 (D3, D4, E1/E5 step chain router, provider probe, Nhà cung cấp & Model page)
goal: Let the Owner run each AI feature on an ordered chain of up to 4 model steps across OpenRouter and direct providers (Owner order 04/11: OpenRouter, then Anthropic, Gemini paid key, OpenAI, DeepSeek), with provider switches, data-class limits, a Postgres circuit breaker, a total deadline and a per-turn cost cap (0.02 USD default), and see provider health and key status in Admin without ever handling a key. D3 adds steps and total_deadline_ms to model_route_versions (backward compatible: no steps means today's primary + fallback); D4 adds ai_providers and ai_provider_health with list/set/record RPCs; the shared router walks steps and records step spans; a new admin-ai-provider-probe function checks keys cheaply. Also fixes the A5 low finding: a stored VI persona prompt that fails the injection guard falls back to the VI code default, not the EN row. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: Migration D3 adds model_route_versions.steps jsonb (1-4 steps of provider, model, timeout_ms, max_tokens, temperature, json_mode, reasoning), total_deadline_ms (5-140 s) and publish_note, extends the provider checks with deepseek, and publish_model_route_config accepts optional steps, total_deadline_ms and note while a v2 payload without them behaves exactly as before; steps must agree with the primary/fallback columns.

Migration D4 adds ai_providers (seeded openrouter 1 enabled sensitive, anthropic 2, gemini 3, openai 4, deepseek 5 public only; direct providers disabled) and ai_provider_health with RLS on and no client table access; list_ai_providers needs ai.read and returns configured yes/no, health and 24 h trace counts, never secret values; set_ai_provider needs ai.manage and audits; record_ai_provider_probe is service role only.

Shared router: a route without steps behaves as today (same candidates, fallback rules and timeouts). With steps it walks them in order, skips disabled providers, missing secrets, providers below the feature data class and open circuits, moves on for transient, 429, 402, 401/403, 404 model, context length and one format failure, never after a safety block, respects the total deadline and the cost cap, sends OpenRouter ZDR/deny on every feature, and records step index, provider, error class, HTTP status, cost and outcome (ok / ok_fallback / canned / safety_block).

admin-ai-provider-probe (ai.manage) reports configured yes/no per provider from env presence and classifies a minimal call as ok / bad_key / no_credit / unreachable, writes ai_provider_health and an audit row through the service role, and never returns or logs secret values.

Admin: Nhà cung cấp & Model page with the provider table (order, on/off, configured, data class, 24 h health, circuit), Kiểm tra khóa for ai.manage, no key input; per-feature step chain editor (max 4 rows, catalogue-only models, per-step timeout, total deadline at most 140 s) with Lưu nháp and Xem lại & phát hành (diff + note) for ai.manage; missing RPC messages name the migration; text escaped; the Model Router page is in Vietnamese.

PGlite verification, Deno tests and deno check of every AI function, jsdom admin tests, validate-admin-contract, validate:backend, supabase:check, validate-admin-workflow-catalog and preflight --ci pass (known Windows CRLF-only failure excepted).

securityReview.authzRls: ai_providers and ai_provider_health have RLS on and no grants to anon/authenticated; reads only through list_ai_providers (ai.read), writes through set_ai_provider (ai.manage, audited) and record_ai_provider_probe (service_role only); publish_model_route_config keeps ai.manage; admin-ai-provider-probe checks ai.manage with the caller's session before using the service role.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No user data in the new tables; traces keep their existing redaction; data class rules prevent sending sensitive feature data to providers not allowed for it.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Secret values are never read into responses, logs, traces or the database: presence is checked with Deno.env.get(name) truthiness; the probe sends the key only in the provider's auth header and stores only the result class and HTTP status.
securityReview.externalInput: RPCs and the Edge contract validate provider names, model text, step count and numeric bounds; Admin escapes every value; the chain editor offers catalogue models only.
securityReview.dependencies: No package added to the repository.
